optSubtitle.message: Sort your YouTube subscriptions feed into themes.

optPermissionTitle.message: Access to YouTube is still needed

optPermissionText.message: Without it the extension can't show the pills or import your channels. In Safari's prompt, choose “Always Allow on This Website”.

optPermissionHelp.message: If no prompt appeared, allow it manually: Safari › Settings › Extensions › Subscriptions Filter › Edit Websites…, and set youtube.com to Allow.

optWelcomeStep1.message: Import the channels you are subscribed to.

optWelcomeStep2.message: Check the suggested themes and their keywords.

optWelcomeStep3.message: Review the automatic classification and adjust what you need.

optImportHelp.message: “Import from YouTube” opens your channel list in a new tab. The extension scrolls through it, reads each channel's name, @handle and description, and then the official YouTube category of its recent videos (about two minutes for 150 channels). Keep the tab open until it says “Done”. Importing again updates the list without undoing your manual changes.

optThemesHelp.message: Each theme has comma-separated keywords, searched in the channel's name, @handle, description and video tags, and can use the official YouTube category. Accents and case don't matter. End a keyword with * to accept continuations: invest* matches “investing” and “investor”.

optSuggestionsHelp.message: Checked themes are created when you click “Classify automatically”.

optWordsHelp.message: Words repeated among uncategorized channels. Click one to create a theme from it:

optIncludeManual.message: Also redo the channels I adjusted by hand

optReviewHelp.message: Click a theme to add the channel to it or remove it. Channels adjusted by hand are marked and aren't changed by the automatic classification; use ↺ to send them back to automatic.

optHideShorts.message: Hide the Shorts shelf while a filter is on
